summary:
Dated observation for FS-GG/.github#5066 (2026-11-07), the fdev successor to learn/home-finite-host-profile after the Home subsystems moved into fdev (environment/home-subsystems-migrated-into-fdev). It records no installed adoption.

Route: INSTALL-FDEV.md, rebound by #5303 to one install tuple at main fd906f54. That tuple is finalizer r5 ce1553e8..., pod operator r2 61f1e5b9... (it pins that finalizer; app_image and pg_image are still None, so every real pod run refuses until a pin-only revision after the image build), operator r6 16b6da1e..., harness r1 b0f5700e..., seal 3db55d80... and ack writer r2 4079753c.... The earlier 7cd6f84f tuple (finalizer c1de5c03..., pod operator 78633c4a...) is superseded. The route is an ordered 15-row sequence: operator r6 and harness before the f1-pre ack so A27 can run against the real record, then the ack, phase A/B, the seal, finalizer, image context, build and pg pull, the pin-only operator, the loop volume, and phase C, a synthetic-input receipt op. Every privileged step is Root-executed through the host administrative route and journalled O_EXCL in fdev-install-journal/ on the bulk-disk source path, chained from install-manifest c0ff55ff....

Pre-install baseline on fdev (2026-11-07): verify_baseline --install-journal gives installedVerified 20 and errors []. user-30034.slice reads 6442450944 / 1280 / 200000 100000, with drop-in d6f4f58d... and seccomp 8bd52f8d.... The f1-pre retirement-failure record is still 3db3a5f3..., and no retirement-ack or install journal exists, so operator r6 refuses every run until step 2. Base image 20a6df20... and reader r4 6625dfb7... exist in the account's storage; no postgres image does. The custody Host build embeds FsggSourceRevision 5d525ad2..., which the phase C prerequisite requires.

Conflict (the finding): the migration left a Quadlet, learn-qualification.service (container learn-qualification, base image, 1 CPU / 2 GiB, SSH on 2228, WantedBy=default.target), running under uid 30034. INSTALL-FDEV step 0 and harness r1's census treat any non-inactive learn-* unit or any ^learn- container as unclean. Every harness case would therefore fail, and the install stopped at step 0 with no effect. Operator r6 and pod operator r2 match only learn-op/fin/pod/pre names, but they share the slice: the pod unit 4G plus the finalizer 512M plus this container's 2G cap exceed the 6G slice, against the pod op's 4.5 GiB headroom gate. The resolution (stop the container for the window, or a reviewed harness exemption) is Root's ruling on #5066.

Limits: installed bytes, units and slice values are live facts. Re-read them on fdev before action. This record grants no operation.
title: fdev LEARN finite pod: pinned install tuple, pre-install baseline and the qualification-container census conflict
